read_by_eye.what_a_designer_would_say: More happens than in the genjutsu run, and more of it happens where you clicked. The row turns pale green and fades back, its amount goes green, a check mark draws itself in the new Paid pill, the Paid card takes a green ring and a "+€4,200.00" beside its total while Paid counts up and Outstanding counts down, and "Paid just now · Undo" takes the button's place for eight seconds. As an answer to "make it feel like the money landed" it is the more literal and the more satisfying of the two. It is also less disciplined: four things confirm one click, the Outstanding card loses 4,200.00 with no sign of where it went, and the status cell is empty in the stills at 120 ms and 350 ms after the click (the old pill has left and the Paid pill has not arrived), on the very row the eye is on. It added an Undo nobody asked for and put a check mark in every Paid pill of the list.

defects_and_notes: The status cell of the clicked row is empty in the stills taken 120 ms and 350 ms after the click (media/click-120ms.png, media/click-350ms.png); the Paid pill is there at 800 ms.
The signed amount appears on the Paid card only; Outstanding counts down with no signed amount.
The run added an Undo (8 s) and a check mark in every Paid pill; neither was asked for.
